topic: Places and Buildings El: Streets & Transport

items.definition: A structure over water or a road.
A large flow of water on land.
A path for cars and people.
items.example: The car drives on the road.

items.definition: A flat open space in a city or town.
A road in a town with shops and houses.
items.example: My house is on this street.

items.definition: A place where buses stop and start for long distance
items.example: The bus station is very big.

items.definition: A place where you leave your car.
items.example: I park my car in the car park.

items.definition: A place where trains stop and people go.
items.example: I take the train at the railway station.
